note: Subject layer (layer 5) for the ORIGINAL (Human) faction. Keys are runtime art subjects from src/assets/chibi-art-v7.ts. Batch beads add and refine subjects here; the roster notes in docs/art/factions/ORIGINAL.md give each role's distinguishing silhouette. Batch 5 (pulp_wars-67q.11) adds PORTRAIT:<ROLE> interface portraits and ICON:* interface icons.

subjects.UNIT:FIGHTER: Subject: Fighter, a chunky cute sword warrior with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: round light steel-grey helmet with a big bright red crest, oversized light steel short sword held up in the right hand, big round shield of plain light grey steel with a darker steel rim and boss held on the left arm in front of the body, bright red tunic covering the torso, light grey gloves, dark slate-grey boots; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:MARKSMAN: Subject: Marksman, a basic archer with a very big head (about half of the figure's height) and a tiny sturdy body: big bright red pointed hood over the head and shoulders showing the face, no helmet under the hood, big tall longbow of pale yellow birch wood held upright in the left hand, a pale tan quiver of white-feathered arrows on the back, long bright red tunic down to the knees, cream-white sleeves and trousers, light grey gloves, dark slate-grey boots and belt; no shield, no sword, no helmet, no brown leather; clearly different from a sword fighter.
subjects.CITY:1: Subject: a small level-1 town: one short round beige cobblestone tower with a bright red cone roof and a big red banner flag, and three chunky cottages with cream plaster walls and solid bright red tile roofs pressed around its foot; no wall; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image.
subjects.CITY:2: Subject: a level-2 town with no people, clearly bigger than a small town: five chunky cottages with cream plaster walls and solid bright red tile roofs packed around a tall square beige cobblestone keep with a big red banner flag, a beige cobblestone wall across the front with a gate and one round beige corner tower with a bright red cone roof; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image.
subjects.CITY:3: Subject: a large level-3 city, the biggest settlement: many chunky houses with cream plaster walls and bright red tile roofs packed inside a crenellated grey stone ring wall with a gate, two round grey stone corner towers with bright red cone roofs and a tall central keep with a big red banner flag; wide and chunky, filling the whole image.
subjects.SITE:VILLAGE: Subject: a tiny neutral hamlet: two or three small round cottages with cream plaster walls on beige cobblestone footings and golden-yellow straw thatched roofs, a short pale wooden fence; no flag, no banner, no tower, no stone wall, and no red or orange anywhere.
subjects.UNIT:RAIDER: Subject: Raider, a chunky cute light horseman with a very big head (about half of his own height) riding a small round short-legged pony seen from the front-right: the pony is sandy yellow with a cream mane and tail and dark grey hooves; the rider wears a big bright red hooded riding cloak over his head, shoulders and back that drapes over the pony's back, and a bright red saddle blanket; he holds a short light steel hand axe raised in the right hand; no helmet, no shield, no lance. Simple shapes and very few details; the pony's hooves are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a small fast rider, not a knight.
subjects.UNIT:GUARD: Subject: Guard, a chunky cute heavy spearman with a very big head (about half of the figure's height) and a tiny sturdy body in a wide braced stance: a heavy round light steel-grey helmet with a wide brim and a nose guard, a huge tall rectangular tower shield painted solid bright red with a thick light steel border held in front of the body on the left arm, covering him from chin to shins, and a long spear with a pale yellow wooden shaft and a light steel point held upright in the right hand, the point high above the helmet; light grey gloves, dark slate-grey boots; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a wall of shield, not a sword fighter.
subjects.UNIT:CAPTAIN: Subject: Captain, a chunky cute medieval army officer with a very big head (about half of the figure's height) and a tiny sturdy body: a soft round bright red medieval cap with a big white feather, a friendly face with a small moustache, a bright red long coat-tunic with a cream sash, holding a tall pale yellow wooden banner pole upright in the left hand with a big square bright red banner flag flying above his head, and a small cream-white hunting horn on a strap at his hip; dark slate-grey boots; no shield, no helmet, no bow; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a commander with a flag.
subjects.UNIT:CATAPULT: Subject: Catapult, a chunky cute wooden siege catapult (a medieval mangonel) on four chunky wheels, built of pale yellow-tan wood with light steel bands, its long throwing arm raised with a sling bucket holding a round grey stone, a big bright red cloth pennant flying from the top of the frame and a bright red cloth draped over the frame, with one small chunky crew man with a very big head in a bright red tunic and a steel cap standing beside it; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels and the crew man's feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a war machine, bigger than a soldier.
subjects.UNIT:KNIGHT: Subject: Knight, a chunky cute armoured knight with a very big head riding a big sturdy white warhorse seen from the front-right: a round light steel great helm with a visor slit and a big bright red plume, a light steel breastplate over chainmail, a long pale yellow wooden lance with a light steel point held upright and slightly forward, the horse covered in a big bright red cloth barding (caparison) from its neck to its knees with a cream trim, light steel chanfron on the horse's head, dark grey hooves; simple shapes and very few details; the horse's hooves are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a heavy mounted knight, bigger and heavier than a small pony rider.
subjects.UNIT:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Juggernaut, a chunky cute giant armoured brute, a huge hulking warrior much wider and taller than a normal soldier, with a big round head in a plain light steel bucket helmet with a visor slit, massive rounded light steel shoulder pauldrons, huge light steel gauntlets, a huge light steel warhammer with a pale yellow wooden handle held in both hands across the body, a big bright red tabard over a barrel chest and belly, chainmail sleeves, thick legs in dark slate-grey boots, wide braced stance; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a giant, not a normal soldier.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:FARM: Subject: Farm, a chunky farmstead: a small barn with cream plaster walls, pale birch timber framing and a big solid bright red tile roof, with three big upright golden wheat sheaves and one round golden haystack standing beside it and a short pale birch fence in front; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:LUMBER_CAMP: Subject: Lumber Camp, a small chunky woodcutters' camp: a small log cabin of pale birch logs with a solid deep crimson red tile roof, a big neat stack of cut pale birch logs beside it, a tree stump with a light steel axe stuck in it, and two small dark green pine trees behind the cabin; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:PORT: Subject: Port, a small chunky harbour pier: a wide wooden pier deck of pale birch planks standing on thick pale birch posts, a small cream plaster harbour hut with a solid deep crimson red tile roof on the pier, a big deep crimson red cloth flag on a tall pole, two chunky mooring posts and a coil of rope; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT: Subject: Monument, a tall slender stone monument: a tall pointed beige cobblestone obelisk rising straight out of the ground with no plinth and no steps, a golden star on its tip, and two long bright red cloth banners hanging down its front from a pale birch crossbar; tall and narrow, much taller than it is wide. Buildings only.
subjects.UNIT:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat, a chunky cute small medieval sailing boat seen from the front-right: a short round pale birch-wood hull with a pale straw-yellow plank line and light steel rivets along the rail, one tall pale wooden mast with one big square bright red cloth sail bellied by the wind and a small bright red pennant on top, a small pale wooden rudder at the stern; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a small fast single-mast boat.
subjects.UNIT:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship, a chunky cute big medieval carrack warship seen from the front-right, much bigger and heavier than a small sailing boat: a tall round pale birch-wood hull with a raised castle at the bow and a raised castle at the stern, both with light steel-grey crenellated rails, a row of small round light steel shields along the side rail, two tall pale wooden masts each with one big square bright red cloth sail and a small bright red pennant on top, a pale wooden bowsprit; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a heavy two-mast warship.
subjects.UNIT:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT: Subject: Embarked transport, a chunky cute wide flat-bottomed wooden cargo barge seen from the front-right, low and wide with no mast and no sail: a pale birch-wood hull with a pale straw-yellow plank line, two pale wooden oars resting out of the sides, a big heap of cargo in the middle covered by a large bright red canvas tarp tied down with pale rope, a short pale wooden pole at the stern with a small bright red pennant; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a slow troop and cargo boat, not a warship.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL: Subject: a windmill: one tall round tower of cream plaster on a beige cobblestone footing with a small pale wooden door, a bright red cone tile roof, and four huge sail arms of pale birch lattice covered with bright red cloth, set in a big X on the front of the roof and much wider than the tower; tall and narrow; no fence, no field. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:SAWMILL: Subject: a sawmill: a long low open-sided shed of pale birch posts under a wide bright red tile roof, a huge round light steel circular saw blade standing upright at its front, and a neat stack of three big pale yellow birch logs with cream bark lying beside it; wide and low; no water wheel, no chimney. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:FORGE: Subject: a blacksmith's forge: a squat square beige cobblestone smithy with a bright red tile roof, a very tall square grey stone chimney rising from the roof with a puff of pale grey smoke, a wide open front arch with a small yellow fire glow inside, and a huge light steel anvil on a pale wooden stump in front of the arch; chunky and heavy. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:WORKSHOP: Subject: a craftsman's workshop: a tall two-storey cream plaster house with pale birch timber framing and a steep bright red tile roof, a huge light steel cogwheel mounted on the front gable, a wide open door with a pale wooden workbench beside it holding a light steel hammer and saw; tall with a steep roof and a big gear. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:MARKET: Subject: a market: two open market stalls side by side with pale birch posts under big striped awnings of bright red and cream cloth, pale wooden crates of yellow pears and green cabbages under them, a round pale wooden barrel and a small hanging light steel scale; wide and low, open with no walls. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:SHIPYARD: Subject: a shipyard: a half-built pale birch-wood boat hull showing its curved ribs, resting upright on pale wooden trestles, a tall pale wooden A-frame crane with a rope and hook leaning over it, and a small boathouse of pale birch planks with a big bright red tile roof behind them; wide and busy. Buildings only.
subjects.PORTRAIT:FIGHTER: Subject: Fighter portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute sword warrior with a huge round head: a round light steel-grey helmet with a big bright red crest, a friendly face with big eyes, a bright red tunic over the shoulders and chest, an oversized light steel short sword raised beside the head and the top of a round plain light grey steel shield at the left shoulder.
subjects.PORTRAIT:RAIDER: Subject: Raider portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute young light horseman with a huge round head and light skin: a big bright red hood and riding cloak over his head and shoulders, a cheerful face, no helmet, and a short light steel hand axe raised beside the head; the bust fills the square.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARKSMAN: Subject: Marksman portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute archer with a huge round head: a tall bright red pointed hood over the head and shoulders showing the face, no helmet, a bright red tunic, a tall pale yellow birch longbow held upright beside him and white-feathered arrows over the shoulder; no shield, no sword.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GUARD: Subject: Guard portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute heavy spearman with a huge round head: a heavy round light steel-grey helmet with a wide brim and a nose guard, the top of a huge solid bright red tower shield with a thick light steel border held in front of the chest, and a long pale yellow spear shaft with a light steel point standing upright beside the head.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CAPTAIN: Subject: Captain portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute medieval army officer with a huge round head: a soft round solid bright red beret with a big white feather, a friendly face with light skin and a small moustache, a solid bright red coat-tunic with a cream sash across the chest, and a big square solid bright red banner flag on a pale yellow wooden pole flying behind his head.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CATAPULT: Subject: Catapult, a chunky cute wooden siege catapult shown whole: a pale yellow-tan wooden frame with light steel bands on four chunky wheels, its long throwing arm raised with a sling bucket holding a round grey stone, a big bright red cloth draped over the frame and a bright red pennant on top; no crew; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:KNIGHT: Subject: Knight portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute armoured knight with a huge round head: a round light steel great helm with a visor slit and a big bright red plume, a light steel breastplate over a bright red surcoat with a cream trim, and a long pale yellow wooden lance with a light steel point held upright beside the helm.
subjects.PORTRAIT:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Juggernaut portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute giant armoured brute: a big round head in a plain light steel bucket helmet with a visor slit, massive rounded light steel shoulder pauldrons, a big bright red tabard over a barrel chest, and a huge light steel warhammer with a pale yellow wooden handle resting over one shoulder; clearly a giant.
subjects.PORTRAIT:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat, a chunky cute small medieval sailing boat shown whole from the front-right: a short round pale birch-wood hull with a pale straw-yellow plank line, one tall pale wooden mast with one big square bright red cloth sail bellied by the wind and a small bright red pennant on top; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship, a chunky cute big medieval carrack warship shown whole from the front-right: a tall round pale birch-wood hull with raised castles at the bow and stern with light steel-grey crenellated rails, two tall pale wooden masts each with one big square bright red cloth sail and a small bright red pennant; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.ICON:TECH:FIELDCRAFT: Subject: a chunky cream canvas walking boot with a dark slate-grey sole and laces stepping forward, with a small bright green leafy sprout growing beside it; the boot and the sprout are the only things in the image.
subjects.ICON:TECH:FORTIFICATION: Subject: a short fence of three sharpened pale birch stakes standing side by side and tied with rope, with a light steel kite shield hanging on the middle stake; no person, no feet, nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:TECH:NAVIGATION: Subject: a chunky round light steel compass seen from above at a slight angle, a pale blue face with a big white star-shaped needle, and a pale birch wooden ring around it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:TEND_WOUNDED: Subject: a big rolled cream-white linen bandage with its loose end unrolling, a small light steel safety pin and one small bright green healing leaf; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:RECOVER: Subject: a round light steel soldier's helmet resting on a rolled cream-white blanket, with a small pale yellow crescent moon floating above it; a peaceful resting scene; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:PROMOTE: Subject: a round light steel soldier's helmet seen from the front with a big golden-yellow chevron stripe painted on it and a small golden star on top; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:PILLAGE: Subject: a big light steel sledgehammer with a pale birch handle lying across a pale birch wooden plank that is snapped in two, with a few pale splinters flying; only the hammer and the broken plank, no person.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:DISBAND: Subject: one empty round light steel soldier's helmet lying upside down on its side, with a small cream cloth bundle tied with string beside it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:WAIT: Subject: a chunky hourglass with a pale birch wooden frame and pale sand running through its glass, standing upright beside a round light steel soldier's helmet; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:CLEAR_FOREST: Subject: a light steel woodcutter's axe with a pale birch handle stuck in a pale birch tree stump, with a few pale wood chips flying; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:REPLANT_FOREST: Subject: a small bright green pine sapling in a round cream clay flower pot, with a light steel garden trowel leaning against the pot; no ground, nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:CULTIVATE_FOREST: Subject: a bundle of ripe golden wheat stalks tied with a pale rope, with a light steel sickle lying across it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:BLAST_MOUNTAIN: Subject: a small chunky grey stone mountain peak with a big bright yellow and white starburst explosion blasting its side and grey rocks flying out; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:REDEVELOP: Subject: a small cream plaster cottage with a pale straw-yellow roof and a light steel builder's hammer and a pale birch builder's square crossed in front of it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:RALLY: Subject: a big cream-white hunting horn blowing, with three short bright yellow sound burst lines coming out of its bell and a small bright red pennant tied to it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:BUILD_ROAD: Subject: a short stretch of beige cobblestone road running diagonally, with a small pale birch wooden signpost standing beside it; no grass, nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:REWARD:SURVEY: Subject: an unrolled cream parchment map with a few simple pale blue and green blobs drawn on it and a small light steel spyglass lying across it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:REWARD:WALLS: Subject: a short chunky section of beige cobblestone city wall with square crenellations and one small round beige stone tower with a slate-grey cone roof; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:REWARD:EXPAND: Subject: a pale birch boundary stake with a small bright yellow pennant, and four short chunky cream arrows pointing outwards from it in four directions; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:HUD:COIN: Subject: one big round gold coin seen almost face on, bright golden yellow with a thick darker gold rim and a simple embossed diamond in the middle; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:HUD:POPULATION: Subject: one big round smiling face of a chunky cute villager with short dark hair, head only, seen from the front; nothing else in the image.
